title: 第15章 未婚妻我们六人你选谁第16章 我不怕有未婚夫陪葬呢
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
懒得搭理听笑声就是个奸商的系统，昭杺柠将注意放在表情包盲盒的抽奖界面。
发现抽奖界面还有一行解释的小字，上面迷惑性地写着：如果你遇见生命危险，你手机里第某某行第某某个表情包可以救你吗？
除了这句迷惑问话，还有关于表情包战斗的解答：表情包盲盒库所有表情包来源，均为宿主自己所收藏过的表情包。
看见这句话的昭杺柠一惊，连忙质问系统：“这话什么意思？”
【宿主，这句话很难理解吗？毕竟你们蓝星表情包千千万，但是你能抽到的表情包，都来源于你自己收藏使用过的】
“你让我捋捋。”昭杺柠深吸一口气，才放平心态询问：“也就是说，我的金手指，是在我遇见危险的时候，随机丢出一个表情包。”
【是的，宿主】
“如果我这张表情包是一只小猫卖萌呢？”昭杺柠咬牙：“这怎么救我？”
【宿主，那这只小猫将对着要杀你的仇人卖萌哦，嘻嘻】
“让我静静！”昭杺柠深呼吸着，感觉自己突然被气得快喘不上气来了。
她抬手按住额头，此刻脑子混乱。
她努力去回想自己从出生到穿越的十九年里面所用过的所有表情包，想找到有没有杀伤力强大的。
拼命想着，还真让她想到一张：“如果有人追杀我，也不知道手拿冲锋枪的唐僧能不能救我？”
可想到自己以前收藏的表情包很多很杂，昭杺柠还没信心能抽到手拿冲锋枪的唐僧。
看着自己当前积分有41点，昭杺柠打算先抽一次看看情况。
【已成功消耗10点积分抽取表情包盲盒一次】
【当前宿主积分：31点】
【恭喜宿主抽得表情包编号#17861号】
昭杺柠好奇看去，是一个满含泪水强颜欢笑的黄脸表情包，旁边还有双手比着爱心。
看着表情包上的哭脸，昭杺柠想笑一下算了，却无语到根本笑不出来。

偏偏系统还在幸灾乐祸。
【宿主，这表情包不错，到时候你被男主追杀，就丢这个表情包来向男主求饶】
“滚吧。”昭杺柠气得直接关掉抽奖界面。
哪怕还剩下31点积分，她此刻根本没有继续抽奖的心思。
毕竟她对她使用过的表情包，还是有些模糊印象的。
不是阴阳怪气别人，就是嘴强王者型。
真正能拿出战斗力的表情包根本没多少，还不一定能抽到。
“总感觉这金手指不太靠谱。”昭杺柠沉思。
她想在这星灵大陆，还得找个更适合她的自保方式才行。
表情包战斗盲盒？
别逗她笑了，纯纯绑定来搞笑的，昭杺柠都不好意思在对战时使用。
怕是仇人见她金手指是这个，都要连吃两大碗饭。
坐着想了半个小时，昭杺柠总算站起身来，她不是想通了，而是想困了。
活动了下手脚，注意到天色已暗，钟离珟还不回来。
“我房间都没安排呢，还不回吗？”
昭杺柠看了木屋一眼，意识到就算钟离珟回来，也没什么房间好给她安排的。
content_en:
Too lazy to pay attention to the system that just sounds like a profiteer, Zhao Hao Ning focused on the lottery interface of the emoticon blind box.
I found that there is a line of small explanation in the lottery interface, which confusingly says: If you are in danger of life, can the emoji pack in the so-and-so line on your phone save you?
In addition to this confusing question, there is also an answer to the emoticon battle: all emoticon sources in the emoticon blind box library are emoticons collected by the host himself.
Zhao Huning was shocked when he saw this sentence and quickly asked the system: "What does this mean?"
[Host, is this sentence difficult to understand? After all, you have thousands of Blue Star emoticons, but the emoticons you can draw are all from your own collection and use]
"You let me figure it out." Zhao Hao Ning took a deep breath before calming down and asked: "In other words, my golden finger is to throw out an emoticon at random when I encounter danger."
[Yes, host]
"What if my emoticon is a kitten showing off its cuteness?" Zhao Hao Ning gritted his teeth: "How can you save me?"
[Host, this kitten will act cute to the enemy who wants to kill you, hee hee]
"Leave me alone!" Zhao Hao Ning took a deep breath, feeling that she was suddenly so angry that she could hardly breathe.
She raised her hand to hold her forehead, her mind was confused at the moment.
She tried hard to recall all the emoticons she had used in the nineteen years from birth to time travel, trying to find any with powerful destructive power.
After thinking hard, she really thought of one thing: "If someone is chasing me, I wonder if Tang Monk holding a submachine gun can save me?"
But thinking that she had collected a lot of miscellaneous emoticons in the past, Zhao Hao Ning was still not confident that she could draw Tang Seng with a submachine gun in his hand.
Seeing that she currently had 41 points, Zhao Hao Ning decided to take a draw first to see how it went.
[Successfully consumed 10 points to extract the blind box of the emoticon pack once]
[Current host points: 31 points]
[Congratulations to the host for winning the emoticon pack number #17861]
Zhao Hao Ning looked curiously and saw a yellow face emoticon filled with tears and forcing a smile, with hands gesturing as hearts next to it.
Looking at the crying face on the emoji, Zhao Hao Ning wanted to laugh, but was so speechless that she couldn't laugh at all.
However, the system is still gloating.
[Host, this emoticon is good. When you are hunted by the male protagonist, throw this emoticon to beg for mercy]
"Go away." Zhao Hao Ning was so angry that she closed the lottery interface directly.
Even though she still had 31 points left, she had no intention of continuing the lottery at the moment.
After all, she still had some vague impressions of the emoticons she had used.
Either he is arrogant and irritating to others, or he is a king with a strong mouth.
There are not many emoticons that can really show combat effectiveness, and you may not be able to draw them yet.
"I always feel that this golden finger is not very reliable." Zhao Hao Ning pondered.
She thought that in this Star Spirit Continent, she had to find a more suitable way to protect herself.
Emoticon combat blind box?
Don't make her laugh. It's purely for fun. Zhao Hao Ning is too embarrassed to use it in battle.
I'm afraid that if her enemies see her golden finger, they will eat two big bowls of rice.
After sitting and thinking for half an hour, Zhao Hao Ning finally stood up. It wasn't that she had figured it out, but that she was sleepy.
After moving his hands and feet, he noticed that the sky was getting dark and Zhongli Sui still hadn't come back.
"My room hasn't been arranged yet, why don't you go back?"
Zhao Haoning took a look at the wooden house and realized that even if Zhong Lizui came back, there would be no room for her to arrange.
